responsibility: Supplies the generated manual cross-reference metadata for user-visible GCN target options declared in gcn.opt. It maps option names such as -march, -mtune, -mstack-size, -mxnack, and -msram-ecc to their GCC manual UrlSuffix entries, allowing GCC’s option infrastructure and generated docs to associate parsed GCN options with the AMD GCN options chapter without affecting code generation semantics.
